name: Goose
desc: open-source general-purpose agent with desktop, CLI and API
desc_zh: 开源通用智能体，提供桌面端、命令行与 API 三种形态
solves: Coding agents only work inside the one editor you licensed. Goose runs the same recipes from a terminal or desktop, against your own files and keys.
solves_zh: 编程 Agent 常常只能在授权过的那个编辑器里跑。Goose 让你在终端或桌面端跑同样的流程，操作你自己的文件和密钥。
best_for: When you want an agent outside your IDE, and the ability to read what it did.
best_for_zh: 当你想在 IDE 之外用 Agent，并且能读到它做了什么。
notes: Not just a coding tool — it runs recipes and MCP extensions locally, donated to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation for neutral governance. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.chenxutan.com/d/5754.html
